comment.caption: Corps joins TVA to celebrate 75th anniversary of Pickwick Dam
comment.note: A 12-barge tow enters Pickwick Lock in Counce, Tenn., Oct. 24, 2013, during a 75th Anniversary event attended by guests from Tennessee, Alabama and Mississippi. Pickwick is one of nine Tennessee Valley Authority navigation locks on the Tennessee River that is operated and maintained by the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Nashville District. (USACE photo by Fred Tucker)
